verdict.rationale: Granular roles and view/edit permissions are a fair question for a work-management platform like ClickUp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents roles, permission levels, or access controls on Spaces, Lists, tasks or Docs. The authentication docs cover only API tokens and OAuth for app access, which is an adjacent feature, not user role management.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
